Jack and Lily had great fun there. There are always many people at the train station. Life is full of small surprises. In fact, families stroll the promenade at dusk.
Jack wants to be a teacher in the future. Jack hopes to visit Chengdu one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the hotel by bike. The factory makes children's toys.
They took many photos at the train station. Jack drinks water after doing sports. Lily's birthday is in June. Fishing boats rest in the small harbour.
Jack learned a lot about English. The weather was sunny that day. Jack thinks English is interesting but a little difficult.
